# Comparisons

The comparison types behind each filter operator, one per family of column types.

## `GraphQLComparison` {#strawchemy-schema-filters-inputs-GraphQLComparison}

[source](https://github.com/gazorby/strawchemy/blob/v0.24.0/src/strawchemy/schema/filters/inputs.py#L201)

Base class for GraphQL comparison filters.

This class provides a foundation for creating comparison filters
that can be used in GraphQL queries. It defines the basic structure
and methods for comparing fields of a specific type.

**Attributes:**

Name | Type | Description
---- | ---- | -----------
`_description` |  | A class variable that stores the description of the comparison.
`_field_node` |  | A private attribute that stores the DTO field node.

### `field_node` {#strawchemy-schema-filters-inputs-GraphQLComparison-field_node}

```python
field_node: QueryNodeType
```

### `has_operator` {#strawchemy-schema-filters-inputs-GraphQLComparison-has_operator}

```python
has_operator() -> bool
```

Whether an operator of this comparison, or of a nested comparison, is set.

### `restricted` {#strawchemy-schema-filters-inputs-GraphQLComparison-restricted}

```python
restricted(data_type: Any, ops: tuple[ComparisonOperator, ...]) -> type[Self]
```

Builds (and caches) a comparison input over ``data_type`` exposing only ``ops``.

The result is a standalone strawberry input carrying every operator attribute (unselected
ones defaulted ``UNSET``) so the query-time ``*Filter.to_expressions`` keep working, and the
same ``__strawchemy_comparison__.filter`` as ``cls``.

**Parameters:**

Name | Type | Description | Default
---- | ---- | ----------- | -------
`data_type` | <code>Any</code> | The scalar type the operators compare against. | *required*
`ops` | <code>tuple[ComparisonOperator, ...]</code> | Selected GraphQL operator names (order-independent). | *required*

**Returns:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>type[Self]</code> | A strawberry input type restricted to the selected operators.

**Raises:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>StrawchemyFieldError</code> | If an operator is not defined for this comparison.

### `to_expressions` {#strawchemy-schema-filters-inputs-GraphQLComparison-to_expressions}

```python
to_expressions(dialect: Dialect, model_attribute: QueryableAttribute[Any] | ColumnElement[Any]) -> list[ColumnElement[bool]]
```

### `restricted` {#strawchemy-schema-filters-inputs-TimeDeltaComparison-restricted}

```python
restricted(data_type: Any, ops: tuple[ComparisonOperator, ...]) -> type[Self]
```

Builds (and caches) a comparison input over ``data_type`` exposing only ``ops``.

The result is a standalone strawberry input carrying every operator attribute (unselected
ones defaulted ``UNSET``) so the query-time ``*Filter.to_expressions`` keep working, and the
same ``__strawchemy_comparison__.filter`` as ``cls``.

**Parameters:**

Name | Type | Description | Default
---- | ---- | ----------- | -------
`data_type` | <code>Any</code> | The scalar type the operators compare against. | *required*
`ops` | <code>tuple[ComparisonOperator, ...]</code> | Selected GraphQL operator names (order-independent). | *required*

**Returns:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>type[Self]</code> | A strawberry input type restricted to the selected operators.

**Raises:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>StrawchemyFieldError</code> | If an operator is not defined for this comparison.
